column1: # context: summary of that switch; "Save photo" is the menu item's name, keep it as translated for that item; the cover picture is the still image shown before a video plays

Tab bar at the bottom
column2: 將分頁列移至底部

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, next to Tab bar at the bottom; puts Facebook's row of tabs at the top of the screen
Tab bar at the top
column2: 將分頁列移至頂端

column1: # context: description of that switch; Facebook shows the tab bar at the top of the screen on some accounts and at the bottom on others
Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom, within thumb reach, on accounts that show it at the top. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 若帳號的 Facebook 分頁列顯示在頂端，將其移至底部，方便拇指操作。重新啟動 Facebook 後生效。

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the search row is the top bar with the Facebook logo, search and Messenger
Moves Facebook's tab bar to the top, under the search row, as older Facebook had it. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 將 Facebook 分頁列移至頂端的搜尋列下方，如同舊版 Facebook。重新啟動 Facebook 後生效。

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, right after Tab bar at the bottom; the bar slides off the screen while you scroll the feed down
Hide the tab bar while scrolling
column2: 捲動時隱藏分頁列

column1: # context: description of that switch; it does nothing while the tab bar is at the top of the screen
The bottom tab bar hides as you scroll down and returns when you scroll up, for more room. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 向下捲動時隱藏底部分頁列，向上捲動時再次顯示，以增加顯示空間。重新啟動 Facebook 後生效。

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, after Hide the tab bar while scrolling; the bottom bar never slides off the screen
Keep the tab bar on screen
column2: 保持顯示分頁列

column1: # context: description of that switch; it greys out while Hide the tab bar while scrolling is on
The bottom tab bar stays put while you scroll, on accounts where Facebook slides it away. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 若帳號的 Facebook 會在捲動時收起底部分頁列，讓它保持顯示。重新啟動 Facebook 後生效。

column1: # context: switch title right after it; the bar at the top with search and Messenger never slides off the screen
Keep the top bar on screen
column2: 保持顯示頂端列

column1: # context: description of that switch
The top bar with search and Messenger stays put while you scroll down, instead of sliding away.
column2: 向下捲動時，含有搜尋與 Messenger 的頂端列會保持顯示，不再滑出畫面。

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, after Keep the top bar on screen; a big screen is a tablet or the inner screen of a folding phone, and the phone layout is the one Facebook shows on a normal phone
Phone layout on big screens
column2: 在大螢幕使用手機版面配置

column1: # context: description of that switch; on a big screen Facebook keeps the tab bar at the top in a wider layout, so the tab bar switches above it do nothing there

A tablet or an unfolded phone gets the layout Facebook uses on a phone, so the tab bar choices above work on the big screen too. Facebook's wider big screen layout goes away. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a big screen yet. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 平板或展開的摺疊手機會使用 Facebook 的手機版面配置，讓上方的分頁列選項也能在大螢幕生效，並取代 Facebook 較寬的大螢幕版面配置。預設停用，因為尚未在大螢幕上測試。重新啟動 Facebook 後生效。

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, after Phone layout on big screens; it makes Facebook's top bar (search and Messenger) and its tab bar partly transparent
See-through bars
column2: 透明列

column1: # context: description of that switch; the feed is the list of posts on Home, and blurred means frosted like glass
The top bar and the tab bar turn see-through, so the feed shows through them as you scroll. On Android 12 and newer the feed behind them is blurred.
column2: 將頂端列與分頁列設為透明，捲動時可透過它們看到動態消息。Android 12 以上版本會模糊處理後方的動態消息。

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance; it keeps Facebook's dark mode on whatever Facebook's own Dark mode setting says
Force dark mode
column2: 強制深色模式

column1: # context: description of that switch; on some tablets Facebook's own Settings page has no Dark mode row
Keeps Facebook dark no matter its own setting. Meant for tablets where Facebook has no Dark mode switch. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 無論 Facebook 本身如何設定，都保持深色模式。適用於 Facebook 沒有深色模式開關的平板。重新啟動 Facebook 後生效。

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, shown with the AMOLED black theme; it makes cards, comments and menus pure black like the page
Black cards
column2: 黑色卡片

column1: # context: description of that switch; a card is a raised panel such as a post or the Menu's profile box, near black is the dark gray the theme gives it

Cards and menus take the page's own color instead of the near black that sets them apart. Buttons and search fields keep a dark gray fill, so you can still see them. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 卡片與選單使用頁面本身的顏色，取代原本用於區隔的近黑色。按鈕與搜尋框仍保留深灰色底色，方便辨識。重新啟動 Facebook 後生效。

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, shown with the AMOLED black theme; it draws a thin gray line in the gap between posts in the feed
Lines between posts
column2: 貼文之間的分隔線

column1: # context: description of that switch; the black page is the AMOLED theme's pure black background
A thin gray line between posts in the feed, so posts without photos don't run together on the black page.
column2: 在動態消息的貼文之間顯示細灰線，避免沒有相片的貼文在黑色頁面上連成一片。

column2: %1$s 代表儲存日期與時間，%2$s 代表相片的 Facebook 編號，%3$s 代表發布者，%4$s 代表發布者的 Facebook 個人檔案編號，%5$s 代表發布日期。無法取得的資訊會略過；若檔名未包含上述項目，會加上日期。若資料夾已有同名檔案，會在結尾加上儲存時間。無效字元會以底線取代。留白則使用預設值 %6$s。

column2: 停用畫面轉場動畫

column2: 解鎖應用程式圖示

column1: # context: settings row under Appearance, right below the Unlock app icons switch; opens Facebook's own App icon page, so use Facebook's name for that page in this language
Pick an app icon
column2: 選擇應用程式圖示

column2: 開啟 Facebook 的「應用程式圖示」頁面，即使該帳號的「設定和隱私」未列出此頁面也可使用。

column2: 在首頁頂端使用所選圖示

column1: # context: toast when the row above finds no App icon page in this Facebook build
This Facebook build has no App icon page.
column2: 此 Facebook 建置版本沒有「應用程式圖示」頁面。

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; Android's own name for the floating video window
Picture-in-picture
column2: 子母畫面

column1: # context: summary of that switch
A playing reel or full-screen video keeps going in a small window when you leave Facebook. Android 12 or later.
column2: 離開 Facebook 時，正在播放的 Reels 或全螢幕影片會在小視窗中繼續播放。需要 Android 12 以上版本。

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; HDR is the high-contrast video and photo format some screens show brighter than everything else
Turn off HDR brightness
column2: 停用 HDR 亮度提升

column1: # context: summary of that switch
HDR videos and photos stay at your screen's usual brightness instead of turning it up to full. They keep their resolution.
column2: HDR 影片與相片維持螢幕平常的亮度，不再提高至最高亮度。解析度不受影響。

column1: # context: switch title under Playback, below Turn off HDR brightness; when a video comes in both HDR and SDR, the SDR copy plays. Keep HDR and SDR as they are
Play SDR versions of HDR videos
column2: 播放 HDR 影片的 SDR 版本

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "the same size" means the same resolution; "the switch above" is Turn off HDR brightness
When Facebook also sends an HDR video in SDR at the same size, play that version instead. The screen doesn't brighten and the picture stays as sharp. Works with the switch above on or off.
column2: 若 Facebook 同時提供相同尺寸的 SDR 版本，改為播放該版本。螢幕不會變亮，畫面仍保持清晰。無論上方開關啟用或停用皆可使用。

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; it makes videos play past the silent stretches of their sound
Skip silent parts
column2: 略過無聲片段

column1: # context: summary of that switch; how-tos are tutorial videos
Videos, reels and stories jump past the quiet stretches in their sound, so talks and how-tos get to the point sooner.
column2: 自動跳過影片、Reels 與限時動態中的安靜片段，讓談話與教學更快進入重點。

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; feed videos stay silent until the user turns their sound on
Keep feed videos muted
column2: 保持動態消息影片靜音

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the speaker is the sound button on a video, volume up is the phone's key
Videos in your feed start with the sound off every time you open Facebook, and only you turn it on. Tap a video's speaker or press volume up to hear it.
column2: 每次開啟 Facebook 時，動態消息中的影片皆以靜音開始，只有你能開啟聲音。點按影片的喇叭或按提高音量鍵即可聆聽。

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; keeps a video's progress bar (the line showing how far it has played) on screen
Keep the progress bar
column2: 保持顯示進度列

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a reel is a short vertical video
A reel's progress bar stays full size, ready to drag. A full-screen video's controls stay until you tap.
column2: Reels 進度列保持完整大小，隨時可拖曳。全螢幕影片的控制項會持續顯示，直到你點按。

column1: Show a reel's time
column2: 顯示 Reels 時間

column1: With Keep the progress bar on, a reel's elapsed and total time stay above the bar. Off, they show only while you drag it.
column2: 啟用「保持顯示進度列」後，Reels 的已播放時間與總時間會持續顯示在進度列上方。停用時只會在拖曳進度列時顯示。

column1: # context: switch title under Playback, after Show a reel's time; a tap on the video's progress bar jumps to that point
Tap the bar to seek
column2: 點按進度列跳轉

column1: # context: description of that switch; the dot is the bar's round handle you drag
Tap anywhere on a reel's or video's progress bar to jump there, instead of dragging the dot.
column2: 點按 Reels 或影片進度列的任何位置即可跳轉，不必拖曳圓點。

column1: # context: switch title under Marketplace; View profile is Facebook's own button on a seller's Marketplace page that opens their regular Facebook profile, so use Facebook's label for it in this language
Show View profile on Marketplace sellers
column2: 顯示 Marketplace 賣家的查看個人檔案按鈕

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Adds a View profile button to every seller's Marketplace page, opening their Facebook profile. Facebook only shows it to some accounts.
column2: 在每位賣家的 Marketplace 頁面新增「查看個人檔案」按鈕，開啟其 Facebook 個人檔案。Facebook 原本只對部分帳號顯示此按鈕。

column1: # context: the Save Facebook's notification sound row under Notifications and its toasts (#83)
Save Facebook's notification sound
column2: 儲存 Facebook 通知音效

column1: Adds Facebook's chime to your phone's notification sounds, for categories set to None. Then pick it in Android's notification settings for Facebook, under Sound.
column2: 將 Facebook 提示音加入手機的通知音效，供音效設為「無」的類別使用。之後可在 Android 的 Facebook 通知設定中，於「音效」選取。

Hide the composer row
column2: 隱藏貼文撰寫列

Hides the "What's on your mind?" row at the top of Home. The create button in the top bar still starts a post.
column2: 隱藏首頁頂端的「在想些什麼？」橫列。仍可用頂端列的建立按鈕撰寫貼文。

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; Clean mode is Facebook's own three-dot menu item on a reel or video that hides the buttons down the side, so use Facebook's name for it in this language (#75)
Always use Clean mode
column2: 一律使用簡潔模式

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "the usual way" means Facebook's own way out of Clean mode
Opens reels and videos in Facebook's Clean mode, which hides the buttons down the side. You can still leave Clean mode as usual. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: 以 Facebook 的簡潔模式開啟 Reels 與影片，隱藏側邊按鈕。仍可照常離開簡潔模式。預設停用，因為尚未使用真實帳號測試。

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch, part of Clean up Reels; each reel plays to its end one time and stops there instead of starting over
Play reels once
column2: Reels 僅播放一次

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "last frame" is the final picture of the video, which stays on screen

A reel stops on its last frame instead of starting over. Tap it to watch again, or swipe to the next one. Feed videos and stories aren't changed. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Reels 會停在最後一格，不再重播。點按可再次觀看，或滑動至下一則。動態消息影片與限時動態不受影響。預設停用，因為尚未使用真實帳號測試。

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch, part of Clean up Reels; reels and videos play in the language they were recorded in instead of an audio track Facebook translated
Keep the original audio
column2: 保留原始音訊

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "dubbed" means the spoken audio was replaced by a translated voice; Meta AI is the company's AI assistant, keep the name
Reels and videos play with the sound they were made with, not a version Facebook dubbed into your language with Meta AI. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Reels 與影片使用製作時的原始音訊，不播放 Facebook 透過 Meta AI 配成你所用語言的版本。預設停用，因為尚未使用真實帳號測試。

Meta's other products
column2: Meta 其他產品

Hide Edits promotions
column2: 隱藏 Edits 推廣

column1: # context: switch title; Threads is Meta's app, keep its name; cross-posting means sharing a Facebook post to Threads as well
Hide Threads cross-posting prompts
column2: 隱藏 Threads 跨平台發布提示

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Threads is Meta's app, keep its name; the share sheet is the panel that opens when you tap Share on a post, use Facebook's own word for it in this language
Hide Threads in the share sheet
column2: 隱藏分享面板中的 Threads

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Muse is Meta's AI agent app, keep its name; the share sheet is the panel that opens when you tap Share on a post, use Facebook's own word for it in this language
Hide Muse in the share sheet
column2: 隱藏分享面板中的 Muse

column1: # context: switch title; Meta Verified is Meta's paid subscription, keep its name
Hide Meta Verified offers
column2: 隱藏 Meta Verified 推廣

column1: # context: switch title; avatar stickers are stickers made from your Facebook avatar
Hide avatar sticker promotions
column2: 隱藏虛擬替身貼圖推廣

column1: # context: summary of the Edits switch; the pill is a small button under a video in the feed that opens Edits
Hides the Edits button in the Reels composer and the Edits pill under videos. You can still make reels in Facebook.
column2: 隱藏 Reels 編輯器中的 Edits 按鈕與影片下方的 Edits 標籤。仍可在 Facebook 製作 Reels。

column1: # context: summary of the Threads switch; the composer is where you write a new post
Facebook stops asking whether to share your post to Threads too. Posting to Facebook works as before.
column2: Facebook 不再詢問是否同時將貼文分享到 Threads。在 Facebook 發布貼文的方式不變。

column1: # context: summary of the Threads share sheet switch; the share sheet is the panel that opens when you tap Share on a post
Removes the Threads button when you share something. All other ways to share stay, in the same order.
column2: 分享時移除 Threads 按鈕。其他分享方式與順序皆保留。

column1: # context: summary of the Muse share sheet switch; Muse is Meta's AI agent app, keep its name
Removes Muse, Meta's AI agent app, when you share something. All other ways to share stay, in the same order.
column2: 分享時移除 Meta 的 AI 代理應用程式 Muse。其他分享方式與順序皆保留。

column1: # context: summary of the Meta Verified switch; the label is a line Facebook adds under the poster's name on some posts
No Meta Verified offer after you post, and no Meta Verified label under the names on posts. Posting works as usual.
column2: 發布貼文後不再顯示 Meta Verified 推廣，也不在貼文名稱下顯示 Meta Verified 標籤。發布功能照常運作。

column1: # context: summary of the avatar sticker switch; promotion slots are the cards Facebook uses to suggest its own features
Hides avatar sticker promotions in comments and elsewhere, and the prompt to make an avatar. Stickers still send.
column2: 隱藏留言等處的虛擬替身貼圖推廣與建立虛擬替身提示。仍可傳送貼圖。

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Imagine is Meta AI's image maker, keep its name
Hide Meta AI's Imagine
column2: 隱藏 Meta AI 的 Imagine

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Meta AI is Meta's assistant and keeps its name; the buttons sit under some posts
Hide other Meta AI buttons under posts
column2: 隱藏貼文下方的其他 Meta AI 按鈕

column1: # context: summary of the Imagine switch; Imagine me is a button Facebook puts under some posts, keep its name; Create story is Facebook's screen for making a story, use Facebook's own name for it in this language
Hides the Imagine me button on posts and the Imagine option when you write a post or create a story. Everything else works as before.
column2: 隱藏貼文上的「Imagine me」按鈕，以及撰寫貼文或建立限時動態時的「Imagine」選項。其他功能照常運作。

column1: # context: summary of the switch that hides the other Meta AI buttons; these are buttons Facebook puts under some posts that open Meta AI; the next button is whatever other button the post would show there
Hides the other Meta AI buttons Facebook puts under posts. The post's next button shows instead, if it has one.
column2: 隱藏 Facebook 放在貼文下方的其他 Meta AI 按鈕。若貼文還有下一個按鈕，則改為顯示該按鈕。

column1: # context: label of a switch under Stories that replays a finished story; it works together with the Stop Story auto-advance switch
Loop stories
column2: 循環播放限時動態

column1: # context: summary of the Loop stories switch; "Stop Story auto-advance" is the label of the switch above it, so use its translation
With Stop Story auto-advance on, a finished story plays again from the start instead of waiting on its last frame. Tap or swipe to move on.
column2: 啟用「停用自動切換限時動態」後，播放完畢的限時動態會從頭重播，而非停留在最後一格。點按或滑動可切換至下一則。

column1: # context: label of a switch under Downloads that adds a Save photo item to the three-dot menu of posts with photos
Save photo in post menus
column2: 在貼文選單加入儲存相片

column1: # context: summary of the Save photo in post menus switch; "Save any photo" is the label of the switch above it and "Save photo" is the menu item, so use their translations
With Save any photo on, a post with photos gets Save photo in its three-dot menu too. A post with several saves each one, one after another.
column2: 啟用「儲存任何相片」後，含有相片的貼文也會在三點選單中顯示「儲存相片」。若有多張相片，會依序儲存每一張。

column1: # context: menu item in a post's three-dot menu that saves the post's one photo to the phone
Save photo
column2: 儲存相片

column1: # context: menu item in a post's three-dot menu that saves every photo of a post with several photos
Save all photos
column2: 儲存所有相片

column1: # context: short message shown when the photos of a post could not start saving
Couldn't save this post's photos. Try again in a moment.
column2: 無法儲存這則貼文的相片。請稍後再試。

column1: # context: row in a comment's long-press sheet that saves the GIF the comment holds; keep it short like Save photo
Save GIF
column2: 儲存 GIF

column1: # context: message after a tap on Save GIF when the save didn't start
Couldn't save this GIF. Try again in a moment.
column2: 無法儲存此 GIF。請稍後再試。

column1: # context: sentence added after the summary of the Save any photo switch; Save GIF is the row's name, keep it as translated for that row
A GIF comment gets Save GIF when you long-press it.
column2: 長按 GIF 留言時，會顯示「儲存 GIF」。

column1: Couldn't save this story's photo. Try again in a moment.
column2: 無法儲存這則限時動態的相片。請稍後再試。

column1: Too many saves at once. Try again when one finishes.
column2: 同時儲存的項目過多。請等其中一項完成後再試。

column1: # context: settings switch under Block Instant Games ads that makes a game's rewarded ad count as watched
Answer rewarded game ads as watched
column2: 將遊戲獎勵廣告回報為已觀看

column1: # context: description under that switch
With Block Instant Games ads on, a game's rewarded ad counts as watched. No ad plays and the game still gives its reward.
column2: 啟用「封鎖即時遊戲廣告」後，遊戲的獎勵廣告會視為已觀看。不播放廣告，遊戲仍會提供獎勵。

Reels quality
column2: Reels 畫質

column1: # context: title of the list that picks the quality video stories start at
Stories quality
column2: 限時動態畫質

column1: # context: first choice in the Reels and Stories quality lists: follow the Default quality row
Same as default
column2: 與預設相同

column1: # context: summary of the Reels quality list when it follows the Playback quality row
Reels follow the Default quality row.
column2: Reels 使用「預設畫質」的設定。

column1: # context: summary of the Stories quality list when it follows the Playback quality row
Video stories follow the Default quality row.
column2: 影片限時動態使用「預設畫質」的設定。

column1: # context: summary of the Reels quality list when it has a quality of its own; %1$s is that choice, such as Highest or Up to 720p
%1$s for reels, whatever Default quality is set to.
column2: Reels 使用 %1$s，不受「預設畫質」設定影響。

column1: # context: summary of the Stories quality list when it has a quality of its own; %1$s is that choice, such as Highest or Up to 720p
%1$s for video stories, whatever Default quality is set to.
column2: 影片限時動態使用 %1$s，不受「預設畫質」設定影響。

Video subfolder

Photo subfolder
column2: 相片子資料夾

column1: # context: dialog text of the Photo subfolder row
Choose a folder for photos inside the save folder. Invalid characters become underscores. Leave it blank to keep photos in the save folder itself.
column2: 在儲存資料夾內選擇相片資料夾。無效字元會以底線取代。留白則將相片直接放在儲存資料夾內。

Videos go to %1$s.

Photos go to %1$s.

Hide the Menu tab badge
column2: 隱藏選單分頁標記

Hide the Groups tab badge
column2: 隱藏社團分頁標記

Now off: %1$s. Turn back on the ones you want in their sections. Tap again to hide this note.
column2: 目前已停用：%1$s。請到各自區段重新啟用你需要的項目。再次點按可隱藏此提示。

Your list of share sheet items to hide will be empty.

Your list of share sheet items to hide will hold %1$d item.
column2: 要隱藏的分享面板項目清單將包含 %1$d 個項目。

column1: # context: the same with several share sheet items
Your list of share sheet items to hide will hold %1$d items.
column2: 要隱藏的分享面板項目清單將包含 %1$d 個項目。

column1: # context: title of the last row on the settings home page; a tap opens the maintainer's Ko-fi page in a browser
Support Hushfacebook
column2: 支持 Hushfacebook

column1: # context: heading row at the end of the Privacy settings page, above a list of the places Facebook shows ads or reports usage
Where ads and tracking are blocked
column2: 廣告與追蹤封鎖範圍

column1: # context: that heading's summary; build means this patched copy of Facebook, switch is a settings toggle
The places Facebook shows ads or reports what you do, and what this build does about each. A line with a switch takes you to it.
column2: 列出 Facebook 顯示廣告或回報你活動的位置，以及此建置版本如何處理各項內容。點按有開關的項目可前往該設定。

column1: # context: a line of that list: ads between posts in the news feed
Ads in the feed
column2: 動態消息中的廣告

column1: # context: a line of that list: ads among the posts on someone's profile
Ads on profiles
column2: 個人檔案上的廣告

column1: # context: a line of that list: ads between stories
Ads in Stories
column2: 限時動態中的廣告

column1: # context: a line of that list: ads between and inside reels
Ads in Reels
column2: Reels 中的廣告

column1: # context: a line of that list: ads among Facebook search results
Ads in search results
column2: 搜尋結果中的廣告

column1: # context: a line of that list: sponsored listings in Marketplace, a product name
Ads in Marketplace
column2: Marketplace 中的廣告

column1: # context: a line of that list: ads inside Facebook's Instant Games, a product name
Ads in Instant Games
column2: 即時遊戲中的廣告

column1: # context: a line of that list: ads Facebook downloads in the background before showing them
Ads downloaded in advance
column2: 預先下載的廣告

column1: # context: a line of that list: Facebook's reports used to target ads
Ad tracking
column2: 廣告追蹤

column1: # context: a line of that list: ads Facebook serves inside other apps on the phone (Audience Network)
# context: added to that line's summary: what blocking it does to those other apps; rewarded ads give a reward for watching
Those apps show their own ads or none, and their rewarded ads may fail.
column2: 這些應用程式會顯示自己的廣告或不顯示廣告，獎勵廣告可能無法運作。

column1: # context: a line of that list: the usage statistics Facebook uploads in the background
Usage statistics uploads
column2: 使用統計資料上傳

column1: # context: added to that line's summary: what else holding the uploads stops, and when a change of its switch takes effect
Facebook's on-phone learning jobs stop too, and a change applies after Facebook restarts.
column2: Facebook 在手機上的學習工作也會停止，變更在重新啟動 Facebook 後生效。

column1: # context: a line of that list: the list of watched reels Facebook is sent
Reel watch history
column2: Reels 觀看紀錄

column1: # context: added to that line's summary: what not sending the history costs
Reels you've already seen may come back.
column2: 已看過的 Reels 可能再次出現。

column1: # context: summary of a line in that list whose patch works with no switch, from the moment the app was patched
Blocked since you patched. There's no switch for it.
column2: 自修補完成起便已封鎖，沒有對應開關。

column1: # context: summary of a line in that list with a switch; %1$s is the switch's name, %2$s the settings page it's on
Its switch is %1$s, in %2$s.
column2: 對應開關是 %2$s 中的 %1$s。

column1: # context: switch title under Links in Hushfacebook settings, next to Share sheet items to hide
Hide group buttons in the share sheet
column2: 隱藏分享面板中的群組按鈕

column1: # context: that switch's summary. Send to group and Send separately are the buttons Facebook's share sheet shows when two or more people are picked
Takes away Send to group when you pick two or more people, and the share sheet's own ways to start a new group, so nothing you share makes a group chat by accident. Send separately stays.
column2: 選取兩人以上時移除「傳送至群組」，也移除分享面板內建立新群組的方式，避免分享時意外建立群組聊天室。「分別傳送」仍會保留。

column1: # context: switch title under Links in Hushfacebook settings, right after Remove tracking from shared links
Share the post's own link
column2: 分享貼文本身的連結

column1: # context: that switch's summary. Copy link is the share sheet item of that name; facebook.com/share/ is a web address and stays as written
Copy link and the share sheet's other link shares give the post's own facebook.com address instead of a facebook.com/share/ link made for that one share.
column2: 「複製連結」與分享面板中的其他連結分享方式，會提供貼文本身的 facebook.com 網址，取代該次分享專用的 facebook.com/share/ 連結。

column1: # context: switch title under Comments in Hushfacebook settings, after Hide related groups
Hide comments with shop links
column2: 隱藏含購物連結的留言

column1: # context: that switch's summary. Shopee, Lazada and Amazon are online shops and stay as written
Hides comments that link to a shop like Shopee, Lazada or Amazon, along with their replies.
column2: 隱藏連至蝦皮、Lazada 或 Amazon 等購物網站的留言，包含其回覆。

column1: # context: switch title under Comments, right after Hide comments with shop links
Hide comments with your words
column2: 隱藏包含指定字詞的留言

column1: # context: that switch's summary. Words to hide is the word list row under News feed and Words that keep a post its second list; use the same translations as those rows
Hides comments containing a word from your Words to hide list in News feed, along with their replies. Words that keep a post keep a comment too.
column2: 隱藏包含「動態消息」中「要隱藏的字詞」清單字詞的留言，包含其回覆。「保留貼文的字詞」也會保留留言。

column2: %1$d / %2$d 個人物、粉絲專頁或網站。清單已使用容量的 %3$d%%。

column2: 尚未選擇檔案。請選擇不超過 %1$d MB 的 .ttf 或 .otf 字型檔。

column2: 移除已儲存的字型檔。重新啟動 Facebook 後會使用手機字型。

column2: 移除已儲存的字型檔。「使用系統字型」仍保持停用。

column1: Saving diagnostic report...
column2: 正在儲存診斷報告…

column1: Selected %1$s. Font changes apply after restarting Facebook.
column2: 已選擇 %1$s。字型變更在重新啟動 Facebook 後生效。

column1: Selected %1$s. Restart Facebook to apply the font change.
column2: 已選擇 %1$s。請重新啟動 Facebook 以套用字型變更。

column2: 已選擇 %1$s。請啟用「使用系統字型」並重新啟動 Facebook 以使用此字型。

column2: 已選擇 %1$s。「使用系統字型」已停用。請啟用並重新啟動 Facebook 以使用此檔案。

column2: 無法複製診斷報告。請再試一次。

column2: 清單最多可容納 %1$d 個人物、粉絲專頁或網站。請移除部分項目後重新儲存。

column2: 未儲存相片。請再試一次。

column2: 未儲存影片。請再試一次。

column2: 此清單超過可用容量。請縮短後重新儲存。

column2: 你的設定已與該檔案相同，不會變更任何內容。

Restart Facebook to apply this change

Restart Facebook to apply %1$d changes
column2: 重新啟動 Facebook 以套用 %1$d 項變更

Facebook closes and reopens on this page.
column2: Facebook 會關閉並重新開啟此頁面。

Restart Facebook
column2: 重新啟動 Facebook

Report a problem
column2: 回報問題

column2: 開啟已填入版本與設定資訊的 GitHub 問題回報。請補充發生的情況。

column1: # context: row near the top of the settings home page; a list of ready-made sets of switches
Quick setups
column2: 快速設定

column1: # context: toast after a long press hides the Quick setups row from the settings home page; the page name is the one holding the row that brings it back

# context: name of a Quick setups choice that hides ads and nags; an adjective, as in a quiet feed
Quiet
column2: 安靜模式

column1: Hides ads, suggestions, promos and prompts, and stops nagging notifications.
column2: 隱藏廣告、推薦、推廣與提示，並停止惱人的通知。

column1: # context: what the Privacy choice of Quick setups turns on; camera roll scans are Hold back camera roll processing
Holds back usage reports and camera roll scans, removes link tracking, and hides your typing and screenshots.
column2: 阻止使用情況回報與相機膠卷掃描，移除連結追蹤，並隱藏你的輸入狀態與截圖行為。

column1: # context: name of the Quick setups choice that puts the switches back as they were after install
Back to defaults
column2: 恢復預設

column1: # context: Lock Facebook is the name of the app lock switch, left as it is
Puts every feature switch but Lock Facebook back the way it started.
column2: 將「鎖定 Facebook」以外的所有功能開關恢復為初始狀態。

column1: # context: toast after a Quick setups choice changed one switch
Changed %1$d setting
column2: 已變更 %1$d 項設定

column1: # context: the same toast for none, or for two or more
Changed %1$d settings
column2: 已變更 %1$d 項設定

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: a save failed for want of a connection
The connection failed. Check your internet and try again.
column2: 連線失敗。請檢查網路後再試。

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the server answered a save with an error, not the file
Facebook's server didn't send the file. Try again in a moment.
column2: Facebook 伺服器未傳送檔案。請稍後再試。

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the file a save fetched came empty or cut short
The download ended before the whole file arrived. Try again.
column2: 檔案尚未完整接收，下載便已結束。請再試一次。

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: a save's work file couldn't be written, for a reason the phone didn't give
Your phone couldn't write the file. Check your free space and try again.
column2: 手機無法寫入檔案。請檢查可用空間後再試。

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the phone was measured and has too little free space for a save
Not enough free space to save this. Free some up and try again.
column2: 可用空間不足，無法儲存。請釋放空間後再試。

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: a video's picture and sound couldn't be converted or joined; Download quality is the setting's name
Your phone couldn't put this video together. Try another Download quality.
column2: 手機無法合併此影片。請嘗試其他「下載畫質」。

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the gallery refused a finished photo or video
The file couldn't be copied into your phone's gallery. Try again in a moment.
column2: 無法將檔案複製到手機相片庫。請稍後再試。

column1: # context: title of a switch on the Menu settings page: whether the Hushfacebook settings shortcut shows when you hold Facebook's launcher icon
Settings shortcut on the app icon
column2: 應用程式圖示上的設定捷徑

column1: # context: title of a switch on the Menu settings page: whether a long press on the Facebook logo opens the Hushfacebook settings
Open settings from the logo
column2: 從標誌開啟設定

column1: # context: title of a switch on the Menu settings page: whether the Hushfacebook settings row shows at the end of Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu
Settings row in Menu
column2: 在選單顯示設定項目

column1: # context: summary of the switch for the Hushfacebook settings shortcut in the launcher icon's menu
Puts Hushfacebook settings in the menu you get by holding Facebook's icon. Off, it leaves that menu.
column2: 在長按 Facebook 圖示的選單中加入 Hushfacebook 設定。停用後會從該選單移除。

column1: # context: summary of the switch for opening the settings with a long press on the Facebook logo
A long press on the Facebook logo at the top of the home feed opens these settings. Off, the long press goes back to Facebook.
column2: 長按動態消息首頁頂端的 Facebook 標誌可開啟這些設定。停用後，長按操作會恢復由 Facebook 處理。

column1: # context: summary of the switch for the Hushfacebook settings row in Facebook's Menu
Adds a Hushfacebook settings row at the end of Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu. Off, the row leaves the Menu.
column2: 在 Facebook 選單的「設定和隱私」結尾新增 Hushfacebook 設定項目。停用後會從選單移除。

column1: # context: summary shown instead of a switch's usual one while it is the only one of the three ways into the settings still on, so it is greyed out
The last way into these settings stays on.
column2: 最後一個設定入口會保持啟用。

column1: # context: switch title on the Appearance settings page: hides Facebook Flex's Data mode bar under the top bar; Data mode is Facebook's own name for paid mode on Flex carriers
Hide the Data mode banner
column2: 隱藏數據模式橫幅

column1: # context: switch title on the Appearance settings page: hides Facebook Flex's purple Free mode bar; Free mode is Facebook's own name for the free text-only mode
Hide the Free mode banner
column2: 隱藏免費模式橫幅

column1: # context: summary of the Hide the Data mode banner switch
On carriers with Facebook Flex, hides the Data mode bar under the top bar and its button to buy mobile data.
column2: 若電信業者提供 Facebook Flex，隱藏頂端列下方的數據模式列及其購買行動數據按鈕。

column1: # context: summary of the Hide the Free mode banner switch; the purple bar is also where you switch back to Data mode
On carriers with Facebook Flex, hides the purple Free mode bar. That bar is also how you go back to Data mode, so turn this off when you want to switch.
column2: 若電信業者提供 Facebook Flex，隱藏紫色的免費模式列。該列也是切回數據模式的入口，因此需要切換時請停用此功能。

column1: # context: switch title under Picture-in-picture on the Playback page: the small window opens only from the Picture-in-picture row this adds to a reel's three-dot More menu, not when you leave Facebook
Only from a reel's More menu
column2: 僅從 Reels 的更多選單開啟

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Picture-in-picture is the name of the row in the reel's menu, translated as the row is; the three dots are the reel's own menu button
Leaving Facebook doesn't open the window. Tap Picture-in-picture in a reel's More menu (the three dots) when you want one. That row shows on upright reels, not wide ones.
column2: 離開 Facebook 不會開啟小視窗。需要時，請點按 Reels 更多選單（三點）中的「子母畫面」。直式 Reels 會顯示該項目，橫式的不會。

column1: # context: switch title under Picture-in-picture on the Playback page; the button floats over a reel or video and opens the small window when tapped
Picture-in-picture button
column2: 子母畫面按鈕

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "the window" is the small picture-in-picture window
Shows a small button at the left edge of a reel or video that has the window ready. Tap it to open the window right away. Works with Picture-in-picture on.
column2: 在已準備好小視窗的 Reels 或影片左側邊緣顯示小按鈕，點按即可立即開啟視窗。需啟用「子母畫面」。

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; it makes videos you post to your own Story ask for high quality when they upload
Upload Stories in HD
column2: 以 HD 畫質上傳限時動態

column1: # context: summary of that switch; standard is the normal upload quality, high the better one
Videos you post to your Story ask Facebook for its high upload quality instead of standard. Applies to the next Story you post.
column2: 發布影片限時動態時，向 Facebook 要求使用高畫質上傳，取代標準畫質。從下一則發布的限時動態起生效。

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; a photo story is a still picture posted to your own Story, and a song added to it plays while the picture shows
Longer music on photo stories
column2: 延長相片限時動態的音樂

column1: # context: summary of that switch; 15 seconds is how long Facebook lets the song on a photo play, and the song's length can be shorter than 30
A song you add to a photo for your Story plays for up to 30 seconds instead of 15. Applies to the next song you pick.
column2: 加入相片限時動態的歌曲最多可播放 30 秒，取代原本的 15 秒。從下一首選擇的歌曲起生效。

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; two fingers spread apart on a story or a profile photo make it bigger
Pinch to zoom
column2: 雙指縮放

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "let go" means lifting your fingers off the screen
Pinch a story or a photo on someone's profile to zoom in. It goes back when you let go.
column2: 以雙指縮放限時動態或他人個人檔案上的相片。放開後會恢復原狀。

column1: # context: switch title under Stories, right below Pinch to zoom; the zoomed picture stays zoomed after the fingers lift
Stay zoomed

column1: # context: row in a video's menu while Skip silent parts is on; the video's silent parts are skipped
Skip silent parts: on
column2: 略過無聲片段：啟用

column1: # context: the same row after a tap; this one video keeps its silent parts
Skip silent parts: off for this video
column2: 略過無聲片段：此影片停用

column1: # context: short message after tapping the row; this video now plays its silent parts
Silent parts play in this video
column2: 此影片會播放無聲片段

Skipping silent parts again
column2: 已恢復略過無聲片段

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; posts Facebook shows from groups the user hasn't joined, which come with a Join button next to the group's name
Hide posts from groups you're not in
column2: 隱藏未加入社團的貼文

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a group post a friend commented on or shared reaches the feed wrapped in the friend's activity, and the switch hides it too
Hides posts from groups you haven't joined, like a friend's post in a public group, and a group post a friend commented on or shared. Posts from your groups stay.
column2: 隱藏你尚未加入社團的貼文，例如朋友在公開社團中的貼文，以及朋友留言或分享過的社團貼文。你已加入社團的貼文仍會保留。

column1: # context: switch title under Search; For you is the section of searches Facebook suggests on the search screen before anything is typed, under a header that reads For you
Hide For you in search
column2: 隱藏搜尋中的為你推薦

column1: # context: summary of that switch; recent searches are the user's own past searches, and the suggestions as you type are the ones under the search box while typing
Hides the For you searches Facebook suggests when you open search. Your recent searches and the suggestions as you type stay.
column2: 隱藏開啟搜尋時 Facebook 建議的「為你推薦」搜尋內容。最近的搜尋與輸入時的建議仍會保留。

column1: # context: switch title under Search; People you may know is Facebook's row of friend suggestions on the search screen before anything is typed, as in Hide "People you may know"
Hide "People you may know" in search
column2: 隱藏搜尋中的「你可能認識的朋友」

column1: # context: summary of that switch; recent searches are the user's own past searches, and the suggestions as you type are the ones under the search box while typing
Hides the People you may know row Facebook shows when you open search. Your recent searches and the suggestions as you type stay.
column2: 隱藏開啟搜尋時 Facebook 顯示的「你可能認識的朋友」橫列。最近的搜尋與輸入時的建議仍會保留。

column1: # context: switch title under Search; on, what the user searches for isn't added to their Facebook search history
Don't save search history
column2: 不儲存搜尋紀錄

column1: # context: summary of that switch; searches already in the history are the user's own past searches, which stay until the user deletes them
What you search for, and the pages and profiles you open from a search, aren't added to your Facebook search history. Searches already there stay until you delete them.
column2: 搜尋內容，以及從搜尋開啟的粉絲專頁與個人檔案，不會加入 Facebook 搜尋紀錄。既有搜尋紀錄會保留，直到你手動刪除。

column1: # context: switch title under Search; on, the Date posted filter in post search asks for a from and to month instead of a list of years; Date posted is Facebook's own filter name in search results
Search date range
column2: 搜尋日期範圍

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Date posted is Facebook's own filter name in post search results, named here as Facebook shows it
The Date posted filter in post search asks for a from and to month, in place of a list of years.
column2: 貼文搜尋中的發布日期篩選會讓你選擇起訖月份，而不是年份清單。

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the audio line is the scrolling line at the bottom of a reel naming its sound, like "Name · Original audio" or a song title
Hide the audio line on reels
column2: 隱藏 Reels 音訊列

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "Original audio" is Facebook's own label, so use the wording Facebook shows in this language
Takes the line with the reel's sound, "Original audio" or a song, off the bottom of reels. Other info stays. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: 移除 Reels 底部顯示「原始音訊」或歌曲的音訊列。其他資訊仍會保留。從下一則 Reels 起生效。

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the message is Facebook's own "This is taking a while. Try checking your network connection." that pops up while a video or GIF loads slowly
Hide the slow connection message
column2: 隱藏連線緩慢訊息

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "This is taking a while" is Facebook's own message, so use the wording Facebook shows in this language
Stops the "This is taking a while" message about your network connection when a video or GIF is slow to load. It keeps loading as before.
column2: 影片或 GIF 載入緩慢時，不再顯示網路連線「這需要一點時間」的訊息。內容仍會照常繼續載入。

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the Reels row is the strip of reel tiles Facebook shows between posts in the news feed, each tile playing a short clip of its reel over and over
Play whole reels in the feed's Reels row
column2: 完整播放動態消息橫列中的 Reels

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a tile is one reel's box in that row
The reels in your feed's Reels row play from the start and keep going, instead of repeating a second or two. Tiles drawn after a change pick it up.
column2: 動態消息 Reels 橫列中的影片會從頭持續播放，不再重複播放一兩秒。變更後繪製的方塊才會生效。

column1: # context: title of the row on the Appearance page, with AMOLED in the build, that takes a color code for dark mode's backgrounds; also its dialog's title
Background color
column2: 背景顏色

column1: # context: text in that row's dialog above the field; %1$s is the lightest gray code it takes, %2$s the color code the patch wrote, both like #0D1117; keep #RRGGBB and #0D1117 as they are
A color code (#RRGGBB) for dark mode's backgrounds, like #0D1117. Grays up to about %1$s work. Leave it blank for %2$s, the color Hushfacebook was patched with.
column2: 深色模式背景的色碼（#RRGGBB），例如 #0D1117。灰色約可使用至 %1$s。留白則使用 %2$s，也就是修補 Hushfacebook 時指定的顏色。

column1: # context: summary of that row while it's blank; %1$s is the color code the patch wrote, like #0D1117
Uses %1$s, the color Hushfacebook was patched with. Type a color code to change it.
column2: 使用修補 Hushfacebook 時指定的顏色 %1$s。輸入色碼即可變更。

column1: # context: summary of that row with a color saved; %1$s is that color code, like #0D1117
Dark mode's backgrounds use %1$s. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 深色模式背景使用 %1$s。重新啟動 Facebook 後生效。

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with text that isn't a color code; %1$s is what was typed; keep #RRGGBB and #0D1117 as they are
%1$s isn't a color. Type a six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #0D1117, or leave it blank for the color Hushfacebook was patched with.
column2: 「%1$s」不是顏色。請輸入六位數色碼（#RRGGBB），例如 #0D1117，或留白以使用修補 Hushfacebook 時指定的顏色。

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with an eight-digit code that isn't fully opaque; %1$s is what was typed; keep #RRGGBB and #0D1117 as they are
%1$s is see-through. Type a solid six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #0D1117.
column2: %1$s 帶有透明度。請輸入不透明的六位數色碼（#RRGGBB），例如 #0D1117。

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with a color too light for Facebook's white text; %1$s is what was typed, %2$s the lightest gray code it takes
%1$s is too light for Facebook's text to stay readable. Pick a darker color. Grays up to about %2$s work.
column2: %1$s 太亮，會使 Facebook 文字難以閱讀。請選擇較深的顏色。灰色約可使用至 %2$s。

column1: # context: import preview sentence: the file sets AMOLED's Background color row back to blank; "AMOLED black theme" is the patch's name, keep it as translated for that patch
If your patched Facebook includes the AMOLED black theme, dark mode's backgrounds will be the color it was patched with.
column2: 若修補後的 Facebook 包含「AMOLED 純黑主題」，深色模式背景將使用修補時指定的顏色。

column1: # context: import preview sentence: the file sets AMOLED's Background color row; %1$s is a color code like #0D1117; "AMOLED black theme" is the patch's name, keep it as translated for that patch
If your patched Facebook includes the AMOLED black theme, dark mode's backgrounds will be %1$s.
column2: 若修補後的 Facebook 包含「AMOLED 純黑主題」，深色模式背景將使用 %1$s。

column1: # context: title of the row on the Appearance page, with AMOLED in the build, that takes a color code for light mode's backgrounds in place of white; also its dialog's title
Light background color
column2: 淺色背景顏色

column1: # context: message in that row's dialog; %1$s is a gray color code like #A6A6A6; keep #RRGGBB and #FFF8E7 as they are
A color code (#RRGGBB) for light mode's backgrounds in place of white, like #FFF8E7. Grays down to about %1$s work, and text gets darker where it needs to. Leave it blank for Facebook's own white.
column2: 以色碼（#RRGGBB）取代淺色模式的白色背景，例如 #FFF8E7。灰色約可深至 %1$s，必要時文字會隨之加深。留白則使用 Facebook 原有的白色。

column1: # context: summary of that row while it's blank, so Facebook's light mode keeps its own white backgrounds
Uses Facebook's own white. Type a color code to change it.
column2: 使用 Facebook 原有的白色。輸入色碼即可變更。

column1: # context: summary of that row once a color is saved; %1$s is the color code
Light mode's backgrounds use %1$s. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 淺色模式背景使用 %1$s。重新啟動 Facebook 後生效。

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with text that isn't a color code; %1$s is what was typed; keep #RRGGBB and #FFF8E7 as they are
%1$s isn't a color. Type a six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #FFF8E7, or leave it blank for Facebook's own white.
column2: 「%1$s」不是顏色。請輸入六位數色碼（#RRGGBB），例如 #FFF8E7，或留白以使用 Facebook 原有的白色。

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with an eight-digit code that isn't fully opaque; %1$s is what was typed; keep #RRGGBB and #FFF8E7 as they are
%1$s is see-through. Type a solid six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #FFF8E7.
column2: %1$s 帶有透明度。請輸入不透明的六位數色碼（#RRGGBB），例如 #FFF8E7。

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with a color too dark for light mode's dark text; %1$s is what was typed, %2$s a gray color code like #A6A6A6
%1$s is too dark for Facebook's light mode text to stay readable. Pick a lighter color. Grays down to about %2$s work.
column2: %1$s 太暗，會使 Facebook 的淺色模式文字難以閱讀。請選擇較淺的顏色。灰色約可深至 %2$s。

column1: # context: import preview sentence: the file sets AMOLED's Light background color row back to blank; "AMOLED black theme" is the patch's name, keep it as translated for that patch
If your patched Facebook includes the AMOLED black theme, light mode's backgrounds will be Facebook's own white.
column2: 若修補後的 Facebook 包含「AMOLED 純黑主題」，淺色模式背景將使用 Facebook 原有的白色。

column1: # context: import preview sentence: the file sets AMOLED's Light background color row; %1$s is a color code like #FFF8E7; "AMOLED black theme" is the patch's name, keep it as translated for that patch
If your patched Facebook includes the AMOLED black theme, light mode's backgrounds will be %1$s.
column2: 若修補後的 Facebook 包含「AMOLED 純黑主題」，淺色模式背景將使用 %1$s。

column1: # context: switch title under News feed, part of Hide suggested and promoted posts; "Related posts" is the heading Facebook shows over a list under a post
Hide "Related posts" under posts
column2: 隱藏貼文下方的「相關貼文」

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "Related posts" is that heading, and Meta AI writes the titles in the list
Hides the "Related posts" list Facebook adds under some posts, with its titles written by Meta AI. The post and its comments stay.
column2: 隱藏 Facebook 在部分貼文下方加入的「相關貼文」清單，其中的標題由 Meta AI 撰寫。貼文與留言仍會保留。

column1: # context: title of the row on the Appearance page that takes your own words for the top of Home in place of Facebook's logo; also its dialog's title and the patch's name; Home is Facebook's home feed tab
Home header text
column2: 首頁標題文字

column1: # context: message in that row's dialog; %1$d is the most characters allowed, 30
Your own words at the top of Home instead of the Facebook logo, up to %1$d characters. They take Facebook's colors in light and dark mode. Leave it blank for Facebook's logo.
column2: 在首頁頂端顯示自訂文字，取代 Facebook 標誌，最多 %1$d 個字元。文字會使用 Facebook 在淺色與深色模式的配色。留白則顯示 Facebook 標誌。

column1: # context: summary of that row while it's blank
Facebook's logo stays at the top of Home. Type your own words to show them there.
column2: 首頁頂端會保留 Facebook 標誌。輸入自訂文字即可在該處顯示。

column1: # context: summary of that row; %1$s is the saved words
The top of Home says %1$s. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 首頁頂端顯示 %1$s。重新啟動 Facebook 後生效。

column1: # context: import preview sentence: the file sets the Home header text row back to blank
The top of Home will show Facebook's own logo.
column2: 首頁頂端將顯示 Facebook 原有的標誌。

column1: # context: import preview sentence: the file sets the Home header text row; %1$s is the saved words; "Home header text" is the patch's name, keep it as translated for that patch
If your patched Facebook includes Home header text, the top of Home will say %1$s.
column2: 若修補後的 Facebook 包含「首頁標題文字」，首頁頂端將顯示 %1$s。

column1: # context: settings row title: picks a picture of your own for the top of Home; pairs with the Home header text row
Home header picture
column2: 首頁標題圖片

column1: # context: settings row title: takes the picked header picture away at once
Remove the header picture
column2: 移除標題圖片

column1: # context: summary under Remove the header picture
Puts your words or Facebook's logo back at the top of Home. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 在首頁頂端恢復顯示自訂文字或 Facebook 標誌。重新啟動 Facebook 後生效。

column1: # context: summary under Home header picture when nothing is picked
No picture chosen. Choose one to show at the top of Home instead of Facebook's logo.
column2: 尚未選擇圖片。請選擇圖片，以取代首頁頂端的 Facebook 標誌。

column1: # context: summary under Home header picture; %1$s is the picked file's name
The saved copy of %1$s is missing. Choose the picture again.
column2: 找不到 %1$s 已儲存的副本。請重新選擇圖片。

column1: # context: summary under Home header picture; %1$s is the picked file's name
Selected %1$s. It shows at the top of Home in place of your words and Facebook's logo.
column2: 已選擇 %1$s。將在首頁頂端顯示，取代自訂文字與 Facebook 標誌。

column1: # context: summary under Home header picture while the picked picture is copied
Copying the picture
column2: 正在複製圖片

column1: # context: toast after a picture is picked; %1$s is the picked file's name
Selected %1$s. Restart Facebook to see it at the top of Home.
column2: 已選擇 %1$s。重新啟動 Facebook 後，即可在首頁頂端看到。

column1: # context: toast when the picked file isn't a picture
That isn't a picture Android can open. The top of Home didn't change.
column2: 這不是 Android 可開啟的圖片。首頁頂端未變更。

column1: # context: toast when the picked picture is too large; %1$d is the limit in megabytes
That picture is over %1$d MB. The top of Home didn't change.
column2: 該圖片超過 %1$d MB。首頁頂端未變更。

column1: # context: toast when the picture's copy can't be written
Couldn't save a copy of that picture. Check that the phone has room, then try again.
column2: 無法儲存該圖片的副本。請確認手機空間足夠，再試一次。

column1: # context: toast when the picked file can't be read
Couldn't open that file. The top of Home didn't change.
column2: 無法開啟該檔案。首頁頂端未變更。

column1: # context: toast after Remove the header picture
Header picture removed. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 已移除標題圖片。重新啟動 Facebook 後生效。

column1: # context: toast when Remove the header picture couldn't save
Couldn't remove the header picture. Try again.
column2: 無法移除標題圖片。請再試一次。

column1: # context: toast when the app holding the picked picture stalls
The app holding that picture is taking too long, so Hushfacebook stopped waiting. The top of Home didn't change.
column2: 提供該圖片的應用程式回應過慢，Hushfacebook 已停止等待。首頁頂端未變更。

column1: # context: toast when a tap on Home header picture comes while the last stalled app still holds a worker
The app holding the last picture still hasn't answered. Try again later.
column2: 提供上一張圖片的應用程式仍未回應。請稍後再試。

column2: Marketplace 進階搜尋

column1: Lets you type rules into Marketplace search. Put a word in quotes, like "word", to keep only titles with it, put a minus in front, like -word, to hide titles with it, and add in:place to keep listings in that place.
column2: 讓你在 Marketplace 搜尋中輸入規則。為詞語加上引號，例如 "詞語"，只保留標題含有它的商品；在前面加減號，例如 -詞語，隱藏標題含有它的商品；加上 in:地點，只保留位於該地點的商品。

column1: Adv. Filters button
column2: 進階篩選按鈕

column1: Adds an Adv. Filters button under Marketplace's Filters on search results. It opens lists of words to keep, words to hide and places, and writes the rules into the search for you.
column2: 在搜尋結果中 Marketplace 的「篩選」下方加入「進階篩選」按鈕。它會開啟要保留的詞語、要隱藏的詞語和地點的清單，並幫你把規則寫進搜尋。

Show when listings went up
column2: 顯示商品刊登時間

column1: A listing's page says how long ago it was listed and the date, next to its place. Facebook only shows it for new listings.
column2: 商品頁面會在地點旁顯示刊登多久以及刊登日期。Facebook 只會對新商品顯示這些。

column1: # context: added after a listing's place on its Marketplace page, like Moncton, NB; %1$s is how long ago in your language from the phone, like 3 weeks ago, %2$s is the date

How Adv. Filters works
column2: 進階篩選的用法

column1: Type a word or a phrase and tap Add. A phrase of more than one word has to be in the title as written. A term matches anywhere in a title, so cat also matches cats. Put it in quotes with a space after it, like "cat ", to leave out cats. Go puts these into the search box and searches again.
column2: 輸入一個詞或片語，然後點按「新增」。由多個詞組成的片語必須照原樣出現在標題中。詞語可比對標題中的任何位置，所以 cat 也會比對到 cats。為它加上引號並在後面加一個空格，例如 "cat "，就能排除 cats。「搜尋」會把這些放進搜尋框並重新搜尋。

column1: You can also type "word", -word or in:place straight into the search box.
column2: 你也可以直接在搜尋框中輸入 "詞語"、-詞語 或 in:地點。

Videos and reels draw together with the rest of the screen, like Disable HW overlays in developer options. Try it if reels look pale until something covers them. Uses a little more battery.
column2: 影片和 Reels 會與螢幕其他部分一起繪製，效果同開發人員選項中的「停用 HW 重疊圖層」。如果 Reels 在被其他東西蓋住之前一直顯得泛白，可以試試。會多耗一點電。
